title: FlexiAI: A Multi-Agent Adaptive AutoML System Based on LLMs

contributions.purpose: 用LLM多智能体端到端自动化AutoML
contributions.mechanism: Task Planner LLM把自然语言指令解析为工作流,分派给数据预处理/特征/选型/训练/评估等专职LLM智能体
contributions.source_quote: An LLM-powered novel multi-agent framework for the automation of AutoML workflows end-to-end, which responds to free-text commands and enables advanced self-organization and decomposition among ML agents.

contributions.purpose: 跨工作流上下文推理与元学习
contributions.mechanism: Shared Memory Module存储历史pipeline,Comparator Agent对比当前与历史执行
contributions.source_quote: A Shared Memory Module that permits contextual reasoning and cross-workflow meta-learning that allows for more optimal decisions based on the historical data and insights by the agents.

contributions.purpose: 保障工作流可靠性与安全
contributions.mechanism: 自治orchestrator+分层验证(Initial Verifier+Stage-Level Verifiers)防提示注入/幻觉
contributions.source_quote: An autonomous orchestrator for coordinating bounded distributed control of execution across modular services, along with sequential validation of emerging workflows to secure integrity, trust, and safety

self_declared_provenance.quote: While some systems like MetaOrch use neural networks for agent selection, FlexiAI's Orchestrator concentrates on a dynamically executable pre-verified plan adjusted through multi-agent interactions and feedback loops.
